Subject: Procurement readiness: payment path options & SOC 2 checklist

Hi Lindsey / Raj —

Thanks again for a great discovery call earlier today. Quick recap and suggested next steps so procurement and security can move forward: 

Recap (short)
- Use-case: real-time clinical notes summarization + embeddings for search, estimated steady-state 15M tokens/month.
- Data: PHI will be redacted before sending; limited to patient identifiers in a subset of calls.
- Security gating: your security team asked for SOC 2 Type II report, executed DPA, and answers to a standard security questionnaire.
- Procurement: your finance mentioned they prefer PO billing, but marketplace is an option if procurement needs faster deployment.

Open asks / next steps
1) Please confirm preferred commercial path (PO vs corporate card vs AWS Marketplace). Which would get you to a purchase order the fastest?
2) We attached our SOC 2 Type II report + a standard DPA template — let us know if you want us to send the redline-ready DPA to your legal directly.
3) If you can share the security questionnaire (or the contact at your security team), we’ll start populating answers this week.
4) Proposed mutual action plan (MAP):
   - EOD Wed (8/4): Redwood to provide SOC2, DPA, pricing for PO and marketplace options, and initial answers to questionnaire
   - Fri (8/6): Procurement confirms path and issues initial PO (if PO chosen) or approves marketplace procurement flow

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf, Redwood_DPA_Template_v1.pdf

If acceptable, I’ll loop in our commercial ops (Karthik) to outline payment terms and timeline.

Best,
Ben

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 02 Aug 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Procurement readiness: payment path options & SOC 2 checklist

Ben — thanks for the clear recap. A few operational notes from commercial/ops perspective: 

1) Payment path tradeoffs (short):
   - PO (Net terms): Best for Nimbus on reporting/tracking; typical lead time 1–3 weeks for standard PO + PO number (depends on internal approvals). We can offer Net 30 or Net 45 for new enterprise pilots.
   - Corporate card: Fastest (minutes) but might require a higher upfront credit limit; less preferable for hospitals that need invoice trails.
   - AWS Marketplace: Fastest procurement acceptance for customers using cloud marketplace; however, pricing is sticky and some finance teams require additional paperwork.

Recommendation: Offer a PO pricing sheet and a Marketplace SKU option. If they need to go to legal on DPA redlines, that will add ~1–2 weeks.

2) Security docs we should push now: SOC2 Type II, DPA, and a completed spreadsheet of the common questionnaire items (I can populate the 'in-scope' items first pass).

3) Pricing/practical: For a pilot at ~15M tokens/month, we should propose a 90-day pilot rate (discounted) with a standard overage rate. I’ll draft a short pricing sheet and attach.

Action items (internal):
- Ben: confirm which procurement route Nimbus prefers and get their procurement contact (Raj seems to be finance).
- Marissa: loop legal for potential DPA redlines and estimate turnaround.
- Karthik: draft PO pricing sheet + marketplace SKU and populate security questionnaire baseline by EOD Wed (8/4).

I attached a quick PO-vs-marketplace one-pager and a checklist of the documents we should surface.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Commercial Ops
karthik_iyer@redwood.com

Attachments referenced: PO_vs_Marketplace_onepager.pdf (internal), Security_Checklist.csv (internal)

Lindsey / Raj —

Thanks — looping in our ops and legal to make this frictionless. Per Karthik’s note below I’ve attached the SOC2 + DPA template. Two quick options for you to consider:

Option A (Preferred for Nimbus if you want invoice + terms): PO (Net 30)
- Redwood will issue invoice per month; standard Net 30 terms.
- We can commit to a 90-day pilot rate (xx% discount) while you evaluate.
- Typical contract routing: Procurement -> Legal -> Sign. Estimated time: 1–2 weeks for standard PO (plus any DPA redlines).

Option B (Fastest): AWS Marketplace
- Quick procurement but limited flexibility on pricing & terms.
- Good if you want to start immediately while legal reviews the DPA.

Attachments included (again):
- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025.pdf (public attestation)
- Redwood_DPA_Template_v1.pdf (redline-ready)

MAP (updated)
- Wed 8/4 EOD: Redwood to upload initial answers for the security questionnaire and send PO & marketplace pricing.
- Fri 8/6: Nimbus to indicate preferred payment path and, if PO, provide procurement contact & initial PO timeline.
